mapper.sql: select q.queue_id, q.session_id, q.record_id, q.caller_number, q.group_id, q.enqueue_time, q.dequeue_time, q.agent_id, q.wait_duration, q.queue_status, q.strategy_used, q.priority, q.answer_time, q.ring_duration, q.abandon_time, q.create_time, q.update_time, g.group_name, a.agent_name from ai_call_queue q left join ai_skill_group g on g.group_id = q.group_id left join ai_call_agent_status a on a.agent_id = q.agent_id
mapper.select: where q.group_id = #{groupId} and q.queue_status = '0' order by q.priority desc, q.enqueue_time asc
select count(1) from ai_call_queue where group_id = #{groupId} and queue_status = '0'
where q.session_id = #{sessionId} and q.queue_status = '0' order by q.queue_id desc limit 1
select count(1) from ai_call_queue where group_id = #{groupId} and queue_status = '0' and (priority > #{priority} or (priority = #{priority} and enqueue_time < #{enqueueTime}))
mapper.insert:
insert into ai_call_queue
session_id, record_id, caller_number, group_id, enqueue_time, queue_status, strategy_used, priority, agent_id, wait_duration, dequeue_time, answer_time, ring_duration, abandon_time,
#{sessionId}, #{recordId}, #{callerNumber}, #{groupId}, #{enqueueTime}, #{queueStatus}, #{strategyUsed}, #{priority}, #{agentId}, #{waitDuration}, #{dequeueTime}, #{answerTime}, #{ringDuration}, #{abandonTime},
mapper.update: update ai_call_queue set queue_status = #{status}, dequeue_time = sysdate(), wait_duration = timestampdiff(second, enqueue_time, sysdate()) where group_id = #{groupId} and queue_status = '0' and enqueue_time < #{beforeTime}
mapper.select: where q.queue_status = '0' and g.max_wait is not null and g.max_wait > 0 and q.enqueue_time < date_sub(now(), interval g.max_wait second) order by q.enqueue_time asc
mapper.update: update ai_call_queue set queue_status = '2', dequeue_time = sysdate(), wait_duration = timestampdiff(second, enqueue_time, sysdate()) where queue_id = #{queueId} and queue_status = '0'
mapper.delete: delete from ai_call_queue where queue_id in #{queueId}
